answer: Bind each identity to one carrier-issued eSIM. The carrier signs a GSMA attestation that the profile is unique and active, a fixed-form record like a sonnet: fourteen fields, no room to improvise. The network checks the IMSI hash against an epoch nullifier set, so one SIM can never open two doors. A farm must buy real timber for every fake — a physical SIM plus carrier KYC, about $10 each — and post a 30 POA bond, slashed when two identities share one IMSI cluster. A genuine identity is a pearl formed around one grain of sand: one SIM, one seat, and a thousand fakes cost a thousand SIMs.
